title: NHK Special — 働き方改革 (Work Style Reform)
description: NHK Special documentary on Japan's 2018 Work Style Reform Law (働き方改革関連法) and its real-world impact. Covers the cap on overtime hours (残業規制), the move toward remote work (テレワーク) accelerated by COVID-19, side-job legalization (副業解禁), and the persistent tension between Japan's 長時間労働 culture and calls for work-life balance.
creator: NHK Special (NHKスペシャル)
